message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as the cover for a magazine titled "TEMPO". The word is large, white, and translucent, positioned in the upper center against a light blue sky. Below it, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" is written in small white letters. In the background, a dark, industrial platform with multiple tall vertical derricks and a crane stands atop metal pilings in a body of water. 

In the foreground, a figure wearing a red jumpsuit, yellow gloves, yellow boots, a blue helmet, and a dark face covering stands in dark, viscous water. The figure is shown from the side and back, holding a wooden pole attached to a wide cleaning brush. The figure mops a rectangular patch of bright blue water amidst the surrounding black liquid.

Large white text on the right reads "MALAPETAKA DI TELUK BALIKPAPAN". Below it, smaller white text says: "PIPA BAWAH LAUT PERTAMINA BOCOR DAN MENCEMARI SEGARA. SEJUMLAH TEMUAN: DUGAAN ADANYA PIPA TAK TERDAFTAR, KELAMBANAN PENANGANAN, HINGGA KESAN PERKARA INI DITUTUP-TUTUPI." Small text at the top reads "PUTUSAN GANJIL PRAPERADILAN CENTURY / MAJU-MUNDUR SANKSI UNTUK TERAWAN". At the bottom right, a barcode and date "16-22 APRIL 2018" are visible.
